20: class ModelLocation(str, Enum):
21:     LOCAL = "local"
22:     CLOUD = "cloud"

25: class ModelRole(str, Enum):
26:     GRAN_MESTRE = "gran_mestre"
27:     HEAVY_EXECUTION = "heavy_execution"
28:     FILTER_FAST = "filter_fast"

33: @dataclass
34: class ModelConfig:
35:     """Configuration for a single model."""
36:     name: str
37:     quantization: str
38:     vram_gb: float
39:     location: ModelLocation
40:     role: ModelRole
41:     parallel_slots: int = 1
42:     description: str = ""
43:     endpoint: Optional[str] = None

48: @dataclass
49: class ModelInstance:
50:     """Runtime instance of a model."""
51:     config: ModelConfig
52:     available_slots: int
53:     active_requests: int = 0
54:     last_used: Optional[str] = None
55: 
56:     def is_available(self) -> bool:
57:         """Check if model has available slots."""
58:         return self.active_requests < self.available_slots
59: 
60:     def acquire_slot(self) -> bool:
61:         """Acquire a slot for a request."""
62:         if self.is_available():
63:             self.active_requests += 1
64:             self.last_used = datetime.now().isoformat()
65:             return True
66:         return False
67: 
68:     def release_slot(self) -> None:
69:         """Release a slot after request completes."""
70:         if self.active_requests > 0:
71:             self.active_requests -= 1

74: class ModelProvider:
75:     """Model provider for hot-swap between local and cloud models."""
76: 
77:     def __init__(self, config_path: str = "/mnt/dados/harness/harness-config.json"):
78:         self.config_path = Path(config_path)
79:         self.config = self._load_config()
80:         self.models: Dict[str, ModelInstance] = {}
81:         self._init_models()
82: 
83:     def _load_config(self) -> dict:
84:         """Load harness configuration."""
85:         with open(self.config_path, "r") as f:
86:             return json.load(f)
87: 
88:     def _init_models(self) -> None:
89:         """Initialize model instances from config."""
90:         for model_key, model_data in self.config["harness"]["models"].items():
91:             config = ModelConfig(
92:                 name=model_data["name"],
93:                 quantization=model_data["quantization"],
94:                 vram_gb=model_data["vram_gb"],
95:                 location=ModelLocation(model_data["location"]),
96:                 role=ModelRole(model_key),
97:                 parallel_slots=model_data.get("parallel_slots", 1),
98:                 description=model_data.get("description", ""),
99:                 endpoint=model_data.get("endpoint"),
100:                 api_key=model_data.get("api_key")
101:             )
102:             self.models[model_key] = ModelInstance(
103:                 config=config,
104:                 available_slots=config.parallel_slots
105:             )
106: 
107:     def get_model_for_route(self, route: str) -> ModelInstance:
108:         """Get appropriate model for a given complexity route.
109: 
110:         Route-based model selection:
111:         - TRIVIAL/SIMPLE → LFM 2.5 (instant checks)
112:         - MEDIUM → Nanbeige 3B (micro-reviews)
113:         - COMPLEX/CRITICAL → Bonsai 27B 1-bit (heavy execution)
114:         - FEATURE → Bonsai + Ornith (full pipeline)
115:         - MIX → Ornith + Bonsai + MoE (max resources)
116:         """
117:         route_upper = route.upper()
118: 
119:         if route_upper in ["TRIVIAL", "SIMPLE"]:
120:             return self.models["filter_fast"]
121:         elif route_upper == "MEDIUM":
122:             return self.models["filter_medium"]
123:         elif route_upper in ["COMPLEX", "CRITICAL"]:
124:             return self.models["heavy_execution"]
125:         elif route_upper == "FEATURE":
126:             return self.models["heavy_execution"]
127:         elif route_upper == "MIX":
128:             return self.models["gran_mestre"]
129:         else:
130:             # Default to Gran-Mestre
131:             return self.models["gran_mestre"]
132: 
133:     def get_model_by_role(self, role: str) -> ModelInstance:
134:         """Get model by role name."""
135:         role_map = {
136:             "gran_mestre": "gran_mestre",
137:             "heavy_execution": "heavy_execution",
138:             "filter_fast": "filter_fast",
139:             "filter_medium": "filter_medium",
140:             "cloud_moe": "cloud_moe"
141:         }
142:         key = role_map.get(role, "gran_mestre")
143:         return self.models[key]
144: 
145:     def get_available_models(self) -> List[ModelInstance]:
146:         """Get all available models with free slots."""
147:         return [m for m in self.models.values() if m.is_available()]
148: 
149:     def get_vram_usage(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
150:         """Get current VRAM usage breakdown."""
151:         total_budget = self.config["harness"]["vram_budget"]["total_gb"]
152:         allocated = sum(
153:             m.config.vram_gb for m in self.models.values()
154:             if m.config.location == ModelLocation.LOCAL
155:         )
156:         reserved = self.config["harness"]["vram_budget"]["kv_cache_reserved_gb"]
157: 
158:         return {
159:             "total_gb": total_budget,
160:             "allocated_gb": allocated,
161:             "reserved_gb": reserved,
162:             "available_gb": total_budget - allocated - reserved,
163:             "models": {
164:                 key: {
165:                     "name": m.config.name,
166:                     "vram_gb": m.config.vram_gb,
167:                     "location": m.config.location.value,
168:                     "active_requests": m.active_requests,
169:                     "available_slots": m.available_slots
170:                 }
171:                 for key, m in self.models.items()
172:             }
173:         }
174: 
175:     def hot_swap(self, old_model: str, new_model: str) -> bool:
176:         """Hot-swap from one model to another.
177: 
178:         In a real implementation, this would:
179:         1. Drain active requests from old model
180:         2. Load new model
181:         3. Update routing table
182:         4. Notify all dependent services
183:         """
184:         print(f"[ModelProvider] Hot-swapping: {old_model} → {new_model}")
185: 
186:         if old_model not in self.models:
187:             print(f"[ModelProvider] ❌ Unknown model: {old_model}")
188:             return False
189: 
190:         if new_model not in self.models:
191:             print(f"[ModelProvider] ❌ Unknown model: {new_model}")
192:             return False
193: 
194:         # In simulation, just log the swap
195:         self.models[old_model].last_used = datetime.now().isoformat()
196:         self.models[new_model].last_used = datetime.now().isoformat()
197: 
198:         print(f"[ModelProvider] ✅ Hot-swap successful")
199:         return True
200: 
201:     def select_model(self, route: str, phase: str) -> ModelInstance:
202:         """Select the best model for a given route and phase.
203: 
204:         Phase-specific model selection:
205:         - Phase 1 (Discovery): Ornith-1.0 9B (Gran-Mestre)
206:         - Phase 2 (Contract): Bonsai 27B 1-bit (generation)
207:         - Phase 3 (Plan): Bonsai 27B 1-bit (planning)
208:         - Phase 4 (Execution): Bonsai 27B 1-bit (execution)
209:         - Phase 5 (Review): Ornith + MoE (cloud audit)
210:         - Phase 6 (Delivery): Ornith + MoE (final verdict)
211:         """
212:         phase_model_map = {
213:             "discovery": "gran_mestre",
214:             "contract": "heavy_execution",
215:             "plan": "heavy_execution",
216:             "execute": "heavy_execution",
217:             "review": "gran_mestre",
218:             "deliver": "gran_mestre"
219:         }
220: 
221:         model_key = phase_model_map.get(phase, "gran_mestre")
222:         model = self.models[model_key]
223: 
224:         # Check if cloud MoE should be used for Phase 5/6
225:         if phase in ["review", "deliver"] and route in ["COMPLEX", "CRITICAL", "FEATURE", "MIX"]:
226:             # Check if local model has issues, use cloud MoE
227:             print(f"[ModelProvider] Phase {phase}: Using cloud MoE for architectural audit")
228: 
229:         return model
230: 
231:     def _derive_endpoint(self, model_key: str) -> Optional[str]:
232:         """Derive llama.cpp endpoint port from model key / local_model_path basename."""
233:         port_map = {
234:             "lfm": 8081,
235:             "nanbeige": 8082,
236:             "ornith": 8083,
237:             "bonsai": 8084,
238:         }
239:         config = self.models[model_key].config
240:         if config.endpoint:
241:             return config.endpoint
242:         model_data = self.config["harness"]["models"].get(model_key, {})
243:         local_path = model_data.get("local_model_path") or ""
244:         basename = Path(local_path).stem.lower()
245:         for token, port in port_map.items():
246:             if token in basename:
247:                 return f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/health"
248:         return None
249: 
250:     def _probe_endpoint(self, endpoint: Optional[str]) -> bool:
251:         """Probe a llama.cpp /health endpoint (3s timeout). Healthy == {'status': 'ok'}."""
252:         if not endpoint:
253:             return False
254:         try:
255:             req = urllib.request.Request(endpoint, headers={"Accept": "application/json"})
256:             with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=3) as resp:
257:                 data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
258:             return data.get("status") == "ok"
259:         except Exception:
260:             return False
261: 
262:     def _cloud_fallback_instance(self) -> ModelInstance:
263:         """Build a cloud free fallback pseudo-instance."""
264:         config = ModelConfig(
265:             name="opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free",
266:             quantization="n/a",
267:             vram_gb=0,
268:             location=ModelLocation.CLOUD,
269:             role=ModelRole.CLOUD_MOE,
270:             parallel_slots=4,
271:             description="Cloud free fallback (used when local protocol fails)",
272:             endpoint=None,
273:         )
274:         return ModelInstance(config=config, available_slots=config.parallel_slots)
275: 
276:     def select_model_with_fallback(self, route: str, phase: str) -> ModelInstance:
277:         """Select local model, probe health; redflag + cloud fallback if offline.
278: 
279:         Local-first protocol: probe llama.cpp /health; on failure mark the local
280:         model with a redflag and fall back to the cloud free model.
281:         """
282:         local_model = self.select_model(route, phase)
283:         endpoint = self._derive_endpoint(local_model.config.role.value)
284:         if self._probe_endpoint(endpoint):
285:             return local_model
286: 
287:         local_model.config.redflag = True
288:         print(
289:             f"[ModelProvider] REDFLAG: {local_model.config.name} offline — "
290:             f"falling back to cloud free"
291:         )
292:         return self._cloud_fallback_instance()
293: 
294:     def _parse_override(self, override_model: str) -> ModelInstance:
295:         """Parse an explicit override id like 'local-bonsai/bonsai-27b' or
296:         'opencode/glm-5.2' into a ModelInstance. No health probe for overrides."""
297:         provider, _, model = override_model.partition("/")
298:         provider_lower = provider.lower()
299:         if provider_lower.startswith("local") or provider_lower in [
300:             "local-bonsai", "local-ornith", "local-lfm", "local-nanbeige",
301:         ]:
302:             name_lower = model.lower()
303:             for inst in self.models.values():
304:                 if name_lower in inst.config.name.lower():
305:                     inst.config.redflag = False
306:                     return inst
307:         config = ModelConfig(
308:             name=override_model,
309:             quantization="n/a",
310:             vram_gb=0,
311:             location=ModelLocation.CLOUD,
312:             role=ModelRole.CLOUD_MOE,
313:             parallel_slots=4,
314:             description="Explicit model override",
315:             endpoint=None,
316:         )
317:         return ModelInstance(config=config, available_slots=config.parallel_slots)
318: 
319:     def resolve_model(
320:         self,
321:         route: str,
322:         phase: str,
323:         override_model: Optional[str] = None,
324:     ) -> ModelInstance:
325:         """Orchestrator-level model selection.
326: 
327:         Priority:
328:         1. Explicit override_model (e.g. 'local-bonsai/bonsai-27b', 'opencode/glm-5.2')
329:            — returned directly, no health probe.
330:         2. Phase-based override: fast model (filter_fast / LFM) for planning phases
331:            (discovery, contract, plan); heavy model (heavy_execution / Bonsai) for
332:            implementation phases (execute, review).
333:         3. Local-first selection with cloud-free fallback (select_model_with_fallback).
334:         """
335:         if override_model:
336:             return self._parse_override(override_model)
337: 
338:         if phase in ("plan", "discovery", "contract"):
339:             fast = self.models["filter_fast"]
340:             if self._probe_endpoint(self._derive_endpoint("filter_fast")):
341:                 return fast
342:             return self._cloud_fallback_instance()
343: 
344:         if phase in ("execute", "review"):
345:             heavy = self.models["heavy_execution"]
346:             if self._probe_endpoint(self._derive_endpoint("heavy_execution")):
347:                 return heavy
348:             return self._cloud_fallback_instance()
349: 
350:         return self.select_model_with_fallback(route, phase)
351: 
352:     def select_resources(self, task: str, phase: str = "", top_k: int = 5) -> Dict[str, list]:
353:         """Seleciona recursos do registry (plugins/mcp/lsp/hooks/skills/subagents)
354:         para a task — escolha automática do orquestrador (Ornith)."""
355:         try:
356:             from core.integration import IntegrationManager
357:             manager = IntegrationManager(str(self.config_path).replace("harness/harness-config.json", ""))
358:             return manager.select_for_task(task, phase, top_k)
359:         except ImportError:
360:             sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent))
361:             from core.integration import IntegrationManager
362:             manager = IntegrationManager(str(Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent))
363:             return manager.select_for_task(task, phase, top_k)
364: 
365:     def get_status(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
366:         """Get current status of all models."""
367:         return {
368:             "models": {
369:                 key: {
370:                     "name": m.config.name,
371:                     "vram_gb": m.config.vram_gb,
372:                     "location": m.config.location.value,
373:                     "role": m.config.role.value,
374:                     "parallel_slots": m.config.parallel_slots,
375:                     "active_requests": m.active_requests,
376:                     "available_slots": m.available_slots,
377:                     "last_used": m.last_used
378:                 }
379:                 for key, m in self.models.items()
380:             },
381:             "vram": self.get_vram_usage()
382:         }
383: 
384: 
385: def main():
386:     """CLI interface for Model Provider."""
387:     import argparse
388: 
389:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Gran-Mestre Model Provider")
390:     parser.add_argument("command", choices=["status", "select", "swap", "vram"],
391:                         help="Model provider command")
392:     parser.add_argument("--route", type=str, help="Complexity route")
393:     parser.add_argument("--phase", type=str, help="Pipeline phase")
394:     parser.add_argument("--override", type=str, help="Explicit model override (e.g. opencode/glm-5.2)")
395:     parser.add_argument("--from", dest="from_model", type=str, help="Model to swap from")
396:     parser.add_argument("--to", dest="to_model", type=str, help="Model to swap to")
397: 
398:     args = parser.parse_args()
399: 
400:     provider = ModelProvider()
401: 
402:     if args.command == "status":
403:         status = provider.get_status()
404:         print(json.dumps(status, indent=2))
405: 
406:     elif args.command == "select":
407:         if not args.route or not args.phase:
408:             print("Error: --route and --phase required for select")
409:             exit(1)
410:         model = provider.select_model(args.route, args.phase)
411:         print(f"Selected model: {model.config.name}")
412:         print(f"Location: {model.config.location.value}")
413:         print(f"Role: {model.config.role.value}")
414:         print(f"VRAM: {model.config.vram_gb}GB")
415: 
416:     elif args.command == "swap":
417:         if not args.from_model or not args.to_model:
418:             print("Error: --from and --to required for swap")
419:             exit(1)
420:         provider.hot_swap(args.from_model, args.to_model)
421: 
422:     elif args.command == "vram":
423:         vram = provider.get_vram_usage()
424:         print(json.dumps(vram, indent=2))
425: 
426: 
427: if __name__ == "__main__":
428:     main()

@dataclass
class ModelInstance:
    """Runtime instance of a model."""
    config: ModelConfig
    available_slots: int
    active_requests: int = 0
    last_used: Optional[str] = None
    reason: Optional[str] = None

def _moe_allowed_phases(self) -> List[str]:
        """Phases where cloud MoE is allowed (policies.json cloud.moe_only_on_phases)."""
        try:
            with open(self.config_path.parent / "policies.json", "r") as f:
                policies = json.load(f)
            indices = policies.get("policies", {}).get("cloud", {}).get(
                "moe_only_on_phases", [5, 6]
            )
            names = [self._PHASE_INDEX_TO_NAME.get(int(i)) for i in indices]
            return [n for n in names if n] or ["review", "deliver"]
        except Exception:
            return ["review", "deliver"]

    def _is_cloud(self, model: ModelInstance) -> bool:
        """True for cloud models (location != local or opencode/* model id)."""
        return (
            model.config.location != ModelLocation.LOCAL
            or str(model.config.name).startswith("opencode/")
        )

    def _best_local_model(self, route: str, phase: str) -> ModelInstance:
        """Best local model available for the route/phase weight.

        Bonsai 27B for heavy work, Ornith 9B for medium, LFM for trivial. Probes
        candidates in priority order; returns the first healthy one, or the best
        candidate (redflagged) when every local server is offline.
        """
        route_upper = route.upper()
        if phase == "execute" or route_upper in ("COMPLEX", "CRITICAL", "FEATURE", "MIX"):
            candidates = ["heavy_execution", "gran_mestre", "filter_medium", "filter_fast"]
        elif route_upper == "MEDIUM":
            candidates = ["gran_mestre", "filter_medium", "heavy_execution", "filter_fast"]
        else:
            candidates = ["filter_fast", "filter_medium", "gran_mestre", "heavy_execution"]

        for key in candidates:
            inst = self.models[key]
            if self._probe_endpoint(self._derive_endpoint(key)):
                inst.reason = f"best local available ({inst.config.name})"
                return inst

        inst = self.models[candidates[0]]
        inst.config.redflag = True
        inst.reason = "all local models offline; cloud MoE blocked for this phase"
        return inst

    def _apply_moe_restriction(self, model: ModelInstance, route: str,
                               phase: str) -> ModelInstance:
        """Enforce policies.json cloud.moe_only_on_phases (default review/deliver).

        Cloud models resolved for a disallowed phase are replaced by the best
        local model, with the selection reason recorded on the instance.
        """
        if not self._is_cloud(model):
            return model
        allowed = self._moe_allowed_phases()
        if phase in allowed:
            return model
        best = self._best_local_model(route, phase)
        best.reason = (
            f"cloud MoE blocked for phase '{phase}' (moe_only_on_phases={allowed}); "
            f"using best local {best.config.name}"
        )
        print(
            f"[ModelProvider] MoE restriction: cloud blocked for phase '{phase}' — "
            f"using {best.config.name} (local)"
        )
        return best

    def select_model_with_fallback(self, route: str, phase: str) -> ModelInstance:
        """Select local model, probe health; redflag + cloud fallback if offline.

        Local-first protocol: probe llama.cpp /health; on failure mark the local
        model with a redflag and fall back to the cloud free model — unless the
        phase is outside policies.json cloud.moe_only_on_phases, in which case
        the best available local model is used instead.
        """
        local_model = self.select_model(route, phase)
        endpoint = self._derive_endpoint(local_model.config.role.value)
        if self._probe_endpoint(endpoint):
            return local_model

        local_model.config.redflag = True
        if phase not in self._moe_allowed_phases():
            print(
                f"[ModelProvider] REDFLAG: {local_model.config.name} offline — "
                f"cloud MoE blocked for phase '{phase}'; using best local"
            )
            return self._best_local_model(route, phase)

        print(
            f"[ModelProvider] REDFLAG: {local_model.config.name} offline — "
            f"falling back to cloud free"
        )
        return self._cloud_fallback_instance()

def resolve_model(
        self,
        route: str,
        phase: str,
        override_model: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> ModelInstance:
        """Orchestrator-level model selection.

        Priority:
        1. Explicit override_model (e.g. 'local-bonsai/bonsai-27b', 'opencode/glm-5.2')
           — returned directly, no health probe.
        2. Phase-based override: fast model (filter_fast / LFM) for planning phases
           (discovery, contract, plan); heavy model (heavy_execution / Bonsai) for
           implementation phases (execute, review).
        3. Local-first selection with cloud-free fallback (select_model_with_fallback).

        Cloud MoE restriction: a cloud model is only honored in the phases listed
        in policies.json cloud.moe_only_on_phases ([5, 6] → review/deliver); for
        any other phase it is replaced by the best available local model.
        """
        if override_model:
            resolved = self._parse_override(override_model)
        elif phase in ("plan", "discovery", "contract"):
            fast = self.models["filter_fast"]
            if self._probe_endpoint(self._derive_endpoint("filter_fast")):
                return fast
            resolved = self._cloud_fallback_instance()
        elif phase in ("execute", "review"):
            heavy = self.models["heavy_execution"]
            if self._probe_endpoint(self._derive_endpoint("heavy_execution")):
                return heavy
            resolved = self._cloud_fallback_instance()
        else:
            resolved = self.select_model_with_fallback(route, phase)

262:     def _probe_endpoint(self, endpoint: Optional[str]) -> bool:
263:         """Probe a llama.cpp /health endpoint (3s timeout) with retry/backoff.
264: 
265:         Healthy == {'status': 'ok'}. Retries ``probe_retries`` times, sleeping
266:         ``probe_backoff * attempt`` seconds between attempts.
267:         """
268:         if not endpoint:
269:             return False
270:         for attempt in range(1, self.probe_retries + 1):
271:             try:
272:                 req = urllib.request.Request(endpoint, headers={"Accept": "application/json"})
273:                 with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=3) as resp:
274:                     data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
275:                 if data.get("status") == "ok":
276:                     return True
277:             except Exception:
278:                 pass
279:             if attempt < self.probe_retries:
280:                 time.sleep(self.probe_backoff * attempt)
281:         return False
